```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.colors import ListedColormap,BoundaryNorm
from matplotlib.patches import Polygon,Patch
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('No es troba el projecte')
    root=root.parent
data=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/practiques-mapes.json').read_text())
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':14,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(8.6,10.1),layout='constrained',sharex=True)
# Decimation keeps the first cell of each four-cell interval. Shift display
# edges to retain those sample centres rather than moving the observations.
extent=(np.array(data['regional_extent'])+np.array([-37.5,-37.5,37.5,37.5]))/1000
for ax,field,title in zip(axes,['regional_single','regional_accumulated'],
                          ['A · Un centre a 30 m','B · 28 mostres a 30 m']):
    values=np.array(data[field]);n=1 if field=='regional_single' else data['controls']['target_count']
    assert set(np.unique(values))<=set(range(n+1))|{255}
    colours=['#f4f7fa','#176b48'] if n==1 else list(plt.colormaps['Greens'](np.linspace(.05,.95,n+1)))
    colours[0]='#f4f7fa'
    cmap=ListedColormap(colours);cmap.set_bad('#d6d9dc')
    norm=BoundaryNorm(np.arange(-.5,n+1.5),cmap.N)
    image=ax.imshow(np.ma.masked_equal(values,255),extent=extent,origin='upper',cmap=cmap,norm=norm)
    for geometry in data['county_boundaries']:
        polys=geometry['coordinates'] if geometry['type']=='MultiPolygon' else [geometry['coordinates']]
        for polygon in polys:
            ax.add_patch(Polygon(np.array(polygon[0])/1000,fill=False,edgecolor='#586571',lw=.8))
    x,y=np.array(data['centre'])/1000
    ax.plot(x,y,'*',color='#bb303c',ms=10)
    ax.annotate('Sector de\nrefineria',xy=(x,y),xytext=(x+10,y+10),fontsize=14,ha='right',
                arrowprops={'arrowstyle':'-','color':'#bb303c'},color='#8f2330')
    ax.set(title=title,ylabel='Nord UTM (km)',aspect='equal')
    ax.ticklabel_format(useOffset=False,style='plain')
    bar=fig.colorbar(image,ax=ax,orientation='vertical',ticks=[0,1] if n==1 else [0,7,14,21,28],fraction=.05,pad=.025)
    bar.set_label('0: ocult · 1: visible' if n==1 else 'Nombre de mostres visibles')
axes[1].set_xlabel('Est UTM (km)')
fig.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor='#d6d9dc',label='Fora del domini comú calculable')],
           loc='outside lower center',frameon=False)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/visibilitat-petroquimica.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None})
plt.close(fig)
```
